label: Blind sample burn 010: MTBS Long Butte fire, MT, 2022-08-20

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.22 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 20 Aug 2022 (90% interval −0.30 to −0.23). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 0 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.02). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02).

evidence.sentence: Optical and radar agree: burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.22 and radar backscatter (VH) fell by 2.3 dB (combined placebo p = 0.03).
